welcome_page.title: E-scooter – Your surroundings
welcome_page.description:
Noise, air, weather, cleanliness and how places look when you ride an e-scooter.

Taking part is voluntary and you can skip any question. Your answers are not linked to your name, and no public authority receives them.

Learn more about SmartUrbanity

Only the SmartUrbanity research team reads your answers. We keep them for research for 36 months; then we delete them or make them anonymous.

final_page.title: Thank you!
final_page.description: Your submission has been recorded. Thank you for taking the time to complete the questionnaire.

questions.text: When you ride an e-scooter, how much does traffic noise bother or annoy you?

options.text: Not at all
Slightly
Moderately
Very
Extremely

questions.text: When you ride an e-scooter, what do you do when the air is bad (exhaust fumes, dust, bad smells)?

options.text: Nothing, it doesn't affect me
I notice it, but I don't change anything
I protect myself, e.g. with a mask
I take another route or travel at another time
I travel another way (e.g. by bus instead of by e-scooter)

questions.text: When you ride an e-scooter, what do you usually do when the weather is bad (rain, wind, cold or great heat)?

options.text: Nothing changes, I travel as usual
It's less pleasant, but I travel the same way
I prepare differently or change route (e.g. clothes, umbrella)
I put off or skip some trips
I travel another way (e.g. by car or bus)

questions.text: When you ride an e-scooter, what do you do when streets or paths are dirty or badly kept (litter, smells, broken glass)?

options.text: It doesn't affect me
I notice it, but carry on as usual
It's unpleasant, but I still go that way
I avoid some stretches
I stop using that route altogether

questions.text: When you ride an e-scooter, do pleasant or unpleasant surroundings affect how you feel?
questions.help: For example buildings, squares, how cared-for a place is and its general feel.

options.text: No, I don't pay attention to them
I notice them, but they rarely make a difference
Sometimes they affect my mood
They affect a lot how I feel on the way
I sometimes choose a route because it's nicer or more interesting

it.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: La tua risposta è stata registrata. Grazie per il tempo dedicato alla compilazione del questionario.
it.#Your surroundings: Il posto in cui ti muovi
it.#When you ride an e-scooter, how much do: Quando vai in monopattino elettrico, quanto ti disturba o ti dà fastidio il rumore del traffico?
it.#When you ride an e-scooter, what do you: Quando vai in monopattino elettrico, cosa fai quando l’aria è cattiva (gas di scarico, polvere, cattivi odori)?
it.#I notice it, but I don't change anythin: Me ne accorgo, ma non cambio nulla
it.#I take another route or travel at anoth: Prendo un altro percorso o mi sposto in un altro orario
it.#When you ride an e-scooter, what do you: Quando vai in monopattino elettrico, cosa fai di solito quando il tempo è brutto (pioggia, vento, freddo o gran caldo)?
it.#Nothing changes, I travel as usual: Non cambia niente, mi sposto come sempre
it.#It's less pleasant, but I travel the sa: È meno piacevole, ma mi sposto allo stesso modo
it.#I prepare differently or change route (: Mi preparo in modo diverso o cambio percorso (ad es. vestiti, ombrello)
it.#I travel another way (e.g. by car or bu: Mi sposto in un altro modo (ad es. in auto o autobus)
it.#I notice it, but carry on as usual: Me ne accorgo, ma vado avanti come sempre
it.#It's unpleasant, but I still go that wa: È spiacevole, ma passo lo stesso da lì
it.#I stop using that route altogether: Smetto del tutto di usare quel percorso
it.#When you ride an e-scooter, do pleasant: Quando vai in monopattino elettrico, l’ambiente intorno, piacevole o spiacevole, influisce su come ti senti?
it.#For example buildings, squares, how car: Per esempio edifici, piazze, quanto un luogo è curato e la sua atmosfera in generale.
it.#I notice them, but they rarely make a d: Ci faccio caso, ma raramente fanno differenza
it.#Sometimes they affect my mood: A volte influiscono sul mio umore
it.#They affect a lot how I feel on the way: Influiscono molto su come mi sento lungo la strada
it.#I sometimes choose a route because it's: A volte scelgo un percorso perché è più bello o più interessante
it.#I protect myself, e.g. with a mask: Mi proteggo, ad es. con una mascherina
it.#I travel another way (e.g. by bus inste: Mi sposto in un altro modo (ad es. in autobus invece che in monopattino)
it.#When you ride an e-scooter, what do you: Quando vai in monopattino elettrico, cosa fai quando strade o percorsi sono sporchi o trascurati (rifiuti, cattivi odori, vetri rotti)?
it.#E-scooter – Your surroundings: In monopattino – Il posto in cui ti muovi
it.#SmartUrbanity - E-scooter – Your surrou: SmartUrbanity - In monopattino – Il posto in cui ti muovi
it.#<p>Noise, air, weather, cleanliness and:
Rumore, aria, maltempo, pulizia e aspetto dei luoghi quando vai in monopattino elettrico.

La partecipazione è volontaria e puoi saltare qualsiasi domanda. Le tue risposte non sono collegate al tuo nome e non vengono inviate a nessuna amministrazione pubblica.

Scopri di più su SmartUrbanity

Solo il gruppo di ricerca SmartUrbanity legge le tue risposte. Le conserviamo per la ricerca per 36 mesi; poi le cancelliamo o le rendiamo anonime.

fr.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: Votre réponse a bien été enregistrée. Merci d’avoir pris le temps de remplir ce questionnaire.
fr.#When you ride an e-scooter, how much do: Lorsque vous roulez en trottinette électrique, dans quelle mesure le bruit de la circulation vous gêne-t-il ou vous agace-t-il ?

fr.#I take another route or travel at anoth: Je prends un autre itinéraire ou je me déplace à un autre moment
fr.#When you ride an e-scooter, what do you: Lorsque vous roulez en trottinette électrique, que faites-vous généralement quand il fait mauvais (pluie, vent, froid ou forte chaleur) ?
fr.#Nothing changes, I travel as usual: Rien ne change, je me déplace comme d'habitude
fr.#It's less pleasant, but I travel the sa: C'est moins agréable, mais je me déplace de la même façon
fr.#I prepare differently or change route (: Je me prépare autrement ou je change d'itinéraire (par ex. vêtements, parapluie)
fr.#I put off or skip some trips: Je reporte ou je saute certains trajets
fr.#I travel another way (e.g. by car or bu: Je me déplace autrement (par ex. en voiture ou en bus)
fr.#I notice it, but carry on as usual: Je le remarque, mais je continue comme d'habitude
fr.#It's unpleasant, but I still go that wa: C'est désagréable, mais je passe quand même par là
fr.#When you ride an e-scooter, do pleasant: Lorsque vous roulez en trottinette électrique, un environnement agréable ou désagréable influence-t-il votre humeur ?
fr.#For example buildings, squares, how car: Par exemple les bâtiments, les places, l'entretien d'un lieu et son atmosphère générale.
fr.#No, I don't pay attention to them: Non, je n'y fais pas attention
fr.#I notice them, but they rarely make a d: Je les remarque, mais elles font rarement une différence
fr.#They affect a lot how I feel on the way: Elles influencent beaucoup ce que je ressens en chemin
fr.#I sometimes choose a route because it's: Je choisis parfois un itinéraire parce qu'il est plus agréable ou plus intéressant
fr.#I protect myself, e.g. with a mask: Je me protège, par ex. avec un masque
fr.#I travel another way (e.g. by bus inste: Je me déplace autrement (par ex. en bus plutôt qu'en trottinette)
fr.#When you ride an e-scooter, what do you: Lorsque vous roulez en trottinette électrique, que faites-vous quand les rues ou les voies sont sales ou mal entretenus (déchets, odeurs, verre brisé) ?
fr.#<p>Noise, air, weather, cleanliness and:
Le bruit, l’air, la météo, la propreté et l’aspect des lieux lorsque vous roulez en trottinette électrique.

La participation est volontaire et vous pouvez passer n’importe quelle question. Vos réponses ne sont pas associées à votre nom et ne sont transmises à aucune administration.

En savoir plus sur SmartUrbanity

Seule l’équipe de recherche SmartUrbanity lit vos réponses. Nous les conservons pour la recherche pendant 36 mois, puis nous les supprimons ou les rendons anonymes.

Lärm, Luft, Wetter, Sauberkeit und das Aussehen der Orte, wenn Sie E-Scooter fahren.

tr.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: Yanıtınız kaydedildi. Bu anketi doldurmak için zaman ayırdığınız için teşekkür ederiz.

tr.#<p>Noise, air, weather, cleanliness and:
Elektrikli scooter kullanırken gürültü, hava kalitesi, hava koşulları, temizlik ve yerlerin görünümü.

Katılım gönüllüdür ve istediğiniz soruyu atlayabilirsiniz. Yanıtlarınız adınızla ilişkilendirilmez ve hiçbir kamu kurumuna gönderilmez.

SmartUrbanity hakkında daha fazla bilgi edinin

fa.#I notice them, but they rarely make a d: متوجه آن‌ها می‌شوم، اما به‌ندرت فرقی ایجاد می‌کنند
fa.#Sometimes they affect my mood: گاهی بر حال من اثر می‌گذارند

fa.#I sometimes choose a route because it's: گاهی مسیری را انتخاب می‌کنم چون زیباتر یا جالب‌تر است

fa.#SmartUrbanity - E-scooter – Your surrou: SmartUrbanity - اسکوتر برقی – محیط اطراف شما
fa.#<p>Noise, air, weather, cleanliness and:
سر و صدا، هوا، آب‌وهوا، پاکیزگی و ظاهر مکان‌ها هنگام استفاده از اسکوتر برقی.
